footnotes.fn_0543611d: Refugee figure for Iraqis in the Syrian Arab Republic is a Government estimate. UNHCR is assisting 18,300 Iraqis at the end of 2015. Figure includes 33,200 Iraqi refugees registered with UNHCR in Jordan. The Government estimates the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_487f7c7c: Since 2024, the number of refugees in Denmark are based on data reported by authorities of persons with valid residence permits for asylum provided by Statistics Denmark as well as temporary protection holders provided by the Danish Immigration Service.
footnotes.fn_48ea83de: The refugee population in Jordan includes 8,900 Iraqis registered with UNHCR.The Government of Jordan estimated the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_7c635ee6: Refugee figure for Iraqis in the Syrian Arab Republic was a Government estimate. UNHCR has registered and is assisting 16,300 Iraqis at the end of 2017. The refugee population in Jordan includes 34,000 Iraqis registered with UNHCR. The Government of Jordan estimated the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_8fd4b726: Refugee figure for Iraqis in the Syrian Arab Republic was a Government estimate. UNHCR has registered and is assisting 15,700 Iraqis at the end of 2018. The refugee population in Jordan includes 34,600 Iraqis registered with UNHCR. The Government of Jordan estimated the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_a933bd02: The refugee population in Jordan includes 34,350 Iraqis registered with UNHCR. The Government of Jordan estimated the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_a983ed4d: The decrease in the stateless population in Denmark between 2022 and 2023 is due to de-duplication of figures reported in previous years.
footnotes.fn_e0a18add: Refugee figure for Iraqis in the Syrian Arab Republic is a Government estimate. UNHCR is assisting 16,900 Iraqis at the end of 2015. Figure includes 33,100 Iraqi refugees registered with UNHCR in Jordan. The Government estimates the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_e5af6ba7: The refugee population in Jordan includes 31,000 Iraqis registered with UNHCR. The Government of Jordan estimated the number of Iraqis at 400,000 individuals at the end of March 2015. This includes refugees and other categories of Iraqis.
footnotes.fn_e66e3ad6: With regards to refugee statistics, since 2024 the number of refugees is Denmark are based on data reported by authorities of persons with valid residence permits for asylum as of 1 January 2024 and increases (e.g. recognitions) or decreases (e.g. refugee status cessation) through the year are as reported by authorities. Figures for temporary protection holders in Denmark are based on data by Eurostat. The figures replace previous refugee stock estimations conducted by UNHCR.
footnotes.fn_f4073f35: With regards to stateless statistics, the figures include: (a) the number of stateless asylum seekers at end-year reported by the Danish authorities; (b) the number of stateless refugees at year-end with valid residence permit as of 1 January 2024 and increases (e.g. recognitions) or decreases (e.g. refugee status cessation) through the year as reported by Danish authorities; and (c) the number of non-displaced stateless persons (those with other non-protection related types of permits) based on data from Statistics Denmark corresponding to the resident population recorded as "Stateless" as of 1 January 2025, deducting the estimated number of stateless refugees at year-end.
footnotes.fn_f6100d39: With regards to stateless statistics, the figures include: (a) the number of stateless asylum seekers at year-end reported by the Danish authorities; (b) the number of stateless refugees by year-end (including temporary protection holders) with valid residence permit as reported by Danish authorities; and (c) the number of non-displaced stateless persons (those with other non-protection related types of permits) based on data from Statistics Denmark corresponding to the resident population recorded as "Stateless" as of 1 January 2026, deducting the estimated number of stateless refugees at year-end.
